serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: Lady Annalie: The truth is, I am a citizen of Paradisium Island. My parents weren’t rich or anything, I was born there. Lady Annalie: I’m sorta ashamed of my circumstances and I don’t wanna talk about them, but as a citizen I could help you get there. You: Damn, I don’t know what to say. Sorry for digging into that topic. Lady Annalie: No worries. Lady Annalie: Don’t get me wrong, it’s not all bad. Because I’m a citizen I can sell recommendations for a quick buck. That’s how I was able to afford this shop to begin with. Lady Annalie: But you see, there’s a limit to the recommendations a single person can give. I made some mistakes before. I trusted the wrong people and now I only have two slots left. You: If it’s about the money I can pay you and we can go there together! Isn’t that the perfect solution? #Annalie.Eyes.sad+Annalie.Mouth.smile Lady Annalie: I-I guess so, but you see, I have some unfinished business here. You: What do you mean? Lady Annalie: I left the island because I hate that place. I am a citizen, but it doesn’t mean that people there treat me with respect. For someone like me, it’s the opposite. Lady Annalie: Because of that I always wanted to find friends here, but that isn't all. Lady Annalie: I wanted to prove to myself that I’m not trash and that I can accomplish something on my own. Lady Annalie: This shop is nice and all, but it was always only a means to an end: becoming a fashion designer. Lady Annalie: I can sell this place any time, but I refuse to go back to that awful island without at least trying. You: If there is anything we can do to help, ask right away! I don’t know much about fashion, but I will do my best. #Annalie.face.pervyGrin Lady Annalie: I’m glad you said that~ Uh-oh… {{wi}}The usual Annalie is back! You: Y-You tricked me, didn’t you?! It was all an act! Lady Annalie: I wouldn’t say tricked. #Annalie.Eyes.pervy+Annalie.Mouth.smile Lady Annalie: Come on~ It won’t be that bad. I just need to borrow your girl for a second. #Annalie.Eyes.pervy+Annalie.Mouth.normal You: What do you mean? Lady Annalie: There’s a fashion show coming up. I want to win it. Lady Annalie: Well, maybe winning it isn’t exactly the correct way to say it. There’s no judges or voting. Only social media buzz. You: I don’t think it would work… Putting a bot on social media is asking for trouble… Lady Annalie: Come on~ I would make a grand debut on the biggest stage in this megacity and then we would leave. #Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.smile Lady Annalie: Wouldn’t that be awesome? A mysterious fashion designer makes an impact only to disappear forever~ I kinda dig the vibe. If we leave immediately I guess it could work… #Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.sad You: Sure, why not. But we would have to leave as soon as possible after the show! Lady Annalie: S-Sure. I don’t know why you would want to leave so fast, but no problem. We could even leave the same day. #Annalie.face.eyeClosed You: Then it’s fine, I guess… Lady Annalie: Yay! #Annalie.face.normal You: But are you sure you are going to win? Lady Annalie: Like I said, there’s no classical winning of sorts. There will be new designers, some underground and niche, but also brands with millions of followers. Lady Annalie: I will be content as long as I make a name for myself, but it would be nice to be the hottest new designer around, even if just for one night. You: Cool. Do you need help with anything else, or is my bo- I mean {f_botName} all you need? Lady Annalie: I got the other model covered. One of my friends is coming for a visit soon and she promised that she would help me. You: That’s cool. I guess there’s nothing for me to do after all. Lady Annalie: I already know what you are thinking and don’t worry, you will help us design the clothes. Damn it… You: If I have to… #Annalie.Eyes.pervy+Annalie.Mouth.smile Lady Annalie: You should be ashamed of yourself. Most men would kill for a chance to see 3 pretty girls trying on clothes. You: Sounds more like a chore to me… #Annalie.face.normal Lady Annalie: Whatever. You can leave now. I need to make some sketches and start preparing materials, I have no more time for you. You: Geez, ok. Lady Annalie: Oh! One more thing! Remember to come to check out the runway. I will send you the location. Bring your girl with you. You: Sure…
